forum.title: How to control using DTM commands (not HCI / ACI)
forum.best_answer_content: Since there are no sample projects that support DTM commands, I understand that I should either use HCI commands or create my own component to convert between HCI and DTM.
forum.content_text:
I want to use the 2-wire Direct Test Mode defined in Bluetooth Core Spec Vol. 6 Part F for RF testing of my STM32WBA custom board.

I've already tried BLE\_TransparentMode. While HCI / ACI commands work, DTM commands don't respond.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/4d387457-320d-40ff-9a42-bedc7d5e5766.png)

Is it impossible to control with 2-wire DTM commands in BLE\_TransparentMode?

Please let me know if there's any way to do this.
